brief: Prioritize Harrowgate Ridge for pre-event attention before the heat event, as its advanced age and prior heat-related faults indicate a reduced margin against mechanical failure ([MG-023]). If this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure ([MG-023]). Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified ([MG-021]).
